description: Land Acquisition - Wathugedaragama East, Hali-Ela D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing multiple land parcels to be acquired for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of the lands, their boundaries, claimants, and the acquisition process, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
